name: Adra Gayrimenkul Yatirim Ortakligi Anonim Sirketi
summary: Adra Gayrimenkul Yatirim Ortakligi Anonim Sirketi operates as a real estate investment trust in Turkey. The company manages portfolios of real estate, real estate projects, real estate-based rights, capital market instruments, and other assets. It also engages in real estate investment activities. In addition, the company engages in establishment, rental, operation of hotels, motels, hostels, campsites, and guesthouses for tourism, and business operations. Adra Gayrimenkul Yatirim Ortakligi Anonim Sirketi was incorporated in 2020 and is headquartered in Izmir, Turkey.
